notes.title: Update №4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178882/1f54823f4efb5b5ab11fa0d5b7289035b4d09d01.jpg

Update
1. Added combat mode WITHOUT automatic aiming
2. Flying left-right (on the keyboard) changed: now the dragon strafes, and does not turn on keys (turns on mouse)
3. Fixed the first person view mode
4. Added key binds in the game (most keys).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178882/ab50d52c53a4bb609f3402432224727da7e478ef.jpg

5. Fixed automatic saving of game settings.
6. Changed the position of the dragon in third person mode
7. Fixed bug with archers
8. Fixed a bug with one of the abilities of the green dragon

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
1. Added the usual save / load to the game
2. Changed the balance of abilities of dragons (the Fire Dragon is weakened, the Nature Dragon and Electric are strengthened).
3. Made color correction.
4. Removed enemy icons from buildings on the minimap
5. Fixed bosses so that Ents could attack them
6. Changed the snake attack
7. Changed the settings for spawning monsters in different locations (in particular, reduced the number of enemies in the 2nd mission).

notes.title: Update №2
notes.content:
What's new:
1. Princess' timer is added when humans reach the Princess - 20 sec.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178882/199409dd1e93086fb678ac61fd243d34047a598e.jpg
2. Level of difficulty is fixed (It was hard to play on the map #2 and on the map#3)
3. Some skills were changed: FireRock, IceBall, Electrostrike
4. Bosses got own avatars
5. Princess's collision is fixed
6. Ents are fixed: they don't collide Princess
7. Night became more light
8. A compass is added
9. Quest signs are added on the Map #7.
10. Princess is changed

notes.title: Update №1
notes.content:
1. Fixed some bugs with level updates and skills
2. Fixed bugs with params and skill description
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178882/6c98cd5f7fac71e8c2fe52e6fec6dd5d6153ed35.jpg
3. Added level of difficulty
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39178882/9ff2ba60c4542cf4a5df643506e9c3296bda495c.jpg
4. Changed the timers in the 2-nd and 3-rd missions 
5. Some objects are added to the 2-nd mission
6. Fixed a bug with one of the russian sounds
7. Fixed some bugs with houses in 2-nd mission
